item.title: WTF is the "Intersection of Art and Technology"
item.author: Shannon Kim
item.content:encoded:
In this video, I talk about what the "intersection of art and technology" actually means and why this label has suddenly become so present in museums, arts grants, and cultural discourse right now. Through Heidegger, Groys, Yuk Hai, Steyerl, Malevich, and Bataille, I examine how the museum lost its original archival function to the internet and is being repurposed by tech wealth as a tool for historicizing its own story of progress.
